correctness.rationale: In \(C_{p^2}\times C_p\), elements of order \(p^2\) partition into \(p\) maximal cyclic subgroups with one common order-\(p\) core, while order-\(p\) elements lie on the \(p+1\) projective lines of \(G[p]\). This proves the exact false-twin quotient. For \(p\ge3\), the neighbor-count formulas give the necessary-and-sufficient peelability condition \((t\le1\text{ and }r\le2)\) or the exceptional two-\(B\)-class pair. Weighted enumeration yields every polynomial coefficient and the minimum sets. The seven-vertex \(p=2\) graph is exhaustively checked. The packaged script independently constructs cyclic subgroups and verifies all formulas.

value.rationale: The theorem gives the complete zero forcing polynomial and every minimum forcing set for the first mixed-exponent rank-two abelian \(p\)-group. The result exposes three distinct subgroup roles, a sharp \(p=2\) boundary, and a five-term collapse for all odd primes. This is a natural infinite-family classification rather than a routine one-off computation.
